package.description: Package folder the plugin infers, passed as --package-path

dryRun.description: Prints each move and makes none, passing --dry-run to swift package update, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

title: Upgrade
description: Moves the lower bound of each remote requirement of Package.swift whose range ends at the next major, the range from: states, to the highest semver tag git ls-remote lists for its repository, prereleases included, among the tags published at or after the bound's own tag, as SwiftPM admits a prerelease only into a range with a prerelease bound, then moves Package.resolved with swift package update
